intelligence.enrichment: Plants store food as starch; iodine solution turning blue-black shows starch, and decolourising the leaf makes that colour change easier to observe. Starch in a decolourised leaf plus iodine solution -> blue-black colour; no detectable starch -> no blue-black colour. The learner correctly applies this rule: Plants store food as starch; iodine solution turning blue-black shows starch, and decolourising the leaf makes that colour change easier to observe. Any iodine colour on a leaf means the leaf has food, even if the result is not blue-black or the leaf was not decolourised.
